_doc: Lip-sync shots. window = song seconds the edit uses (script.md). ref_t0 = song time of the reference audio's first sample (= clip t 0 if the model places the audio at the start); ref_dur = reference length = clip duration. Lead-in: ref_t0 = first sung word - 0.30 s. Tail: covers window end + 0.65 s (largest Seedance lag seen). Optional: measure_window (song span used for the lag; default = window), held (span that must stay open).

LS1.lyric: the West Lake wind sings over water, / like smoothing silk, and late

LS2.lyric: 举杯邀明月，对影成三人

LS3.note: window opens inside the held 寒 (79.64-81.46); the lead-in is cut 0.3 s before 寒's onset; lag is measured on the articulated part (measure_window, clipped to the take's reference audio) - a held note carries no timing; the held 你 is checked as 'held_open' = fraction of frames in 'held' with the mouth open (> 35 % of the take's 5..95 % openness range); script v1.3: LS3 is only 81.5-82.8 (我思念); the held 你 cuts to K_4.3b
